name: [Release] Abyss Miner
desc:
[Current stage : Remaking ]
Welcome, adventurers! Abyss Miner is an adventure game where you explore different areas to search for ores and discover things you've never seen before. Beware—as you dive deeper, environment grows more intense with dangerous creatures lurking in the depths!

A mining game inspired by Made in Abyss.

This game is in its early state, expect bugs/glitches.
Don't forget to join our discord community server!

Console & Mobile is supported, but PC is recommended to play this game.

Console Button
ButtonX - Skip title screen/ Jump/ Climb
ButtonA - SwingPickAxe
ButtonB - Cancel(Grabbing item)
ButtonY - ShirftLock
DPad - Climb Movement
L1/R1 - Select Tool
R2 - Active Tool
